Hi Tom — thanks, and great to hear procurement is moving fast. Below are the practical options and the exact PO fields we require.

PO header / required fields (must be on every PO/invoice):
- PO number (required by ERP)
- Vendor legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Redwood remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc., 401 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Redwood EIN / Tax ID: XX-XXXXXXX
- Billing entity (if you operate multiple legal entities, please map the account code)
- SOW / contract reference and Deal ID (please include MED-2027-119)

Invoice cadence options we support:
1) Monthly usage invoices (standard): you receive a single usage invoice each month (Net30 by default). Credits for milestones are applied as line-item credits on the next monthly invoice once the milestone is confirmed by both parties.
2) Milestone-driven invoicing: if you provide a milestone schedule and the contract references milestone amounts, we can generate invoices per milestone instead of monthly billing. This requires the PO to reference the milestone schedule and to include the Milestone ID field.
3) Hybrid (recommended for your case): monthly usage invoices, with milestone credits posted as negative line items when milestones complete. Works well if you want continuous usage billing and occasional crediting.

Net terms: Redwood standard for new enterprise customers is Net30. Finance can approve Net45 or Net60 on a case-by-case basis for enterprise customers with an established payment history. For first-year engagements we prefer Net30 or prepayment.

Discounts / onboarding credit:
- We can offer an onboarding credit (applied over the first 2–3 invoices) tied to either: (a) an annual prepayment or (b) a minimum committed ARR. Typical structures: 10% credit for 12-month prepay, or a one-time $25,000 onboarding credit for commitments >= $250k ARR.

Attachments: I attached our standard Redwood PO template (redwood_po_template_v2.pdf) — it highlights the PO header fields and the Milestone ID field if you want milestone billing.

Thanks for the ping — quick answers below.

1) Onboarding credit: approved conditionally. Finance can approve a one-time onboarding credit of $25,000 provided:
   - The customer signs a minimum 12-month commitment for >= $250,000 ARR, OR
   - They prepay at least 6 months of committed spend.
   - Credit should be amortized across first two invoices or applied as a single credit line on first invoice per procurement preference.

2) Net terms: we can accept Net45 for new enterprise customers with procurement approval + completion of payment risk checklist. Net60 requires VP-level approval and a brief underwriting call with Treasury.

3) Invoice processing / ERP notes:
   - Please ensure PO includes: PO number, Deal ID (MED-2027-119), Vendor legal name, remit-to address, tax ID, and the customer ERP vendor code if they have one.
   - For milestone credits, include the Milestone ID and date on the credit line so our bookkeeping can tie it to the SOW.
